integrity_statement: A complete analytical proof and a supplementary reproducible finite-section diagnostic are supplied; broader pseudodifferential Weyl methods are credited rather than claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Exact leading singular laws only for finite polynomial coefficient vectors in the compact total-degree regime of normalized Hilbert Fock–Sobolev spaces; no independent audit or absolute publication-priority certification.
title: Sharp singular-value Weyl law for compact polynomial Fock–Sobolev integral sums
